meta.description: The school's document library. Documents are organised by programme and by module.

entete.accroche: Documents are organised by programme and by module.

cartes.texte: A document is a course, an exam, a tutorial, a lab, an exercise or an article.
A submission waits for a review before it is visible.
People download it and rate it.
Students leave an internship review, a project idea, and look at the events.
Suggestions are offered when AI is available.
